shared_elements: dense blocks of script-like glyph signs
glyph signs arranged in ordered rows/columns
standing/elaborately dressed figure in low relief
upright slab-shaped carved panel with framed field
justification: Both depict human figures in low relief combined with dense arrays of ordered glyph signs on an upright framed panel, and both render figures schematically in profile with headgear — a genuinely comparable text-plus-figure scheme. But the specific arrangement differs sharply: A is dominated by one large frontal-bodied, profile-headed figure in ornate regalia flanked by a few glyph blocks, while B relegates a small row of standing figures to a lunette-and-register at the top above a dozen uniform horizontal lines of tiny script, with no monumental figure at all.
